q: What is the impact on FY27 EBITDA if UK visits fall 8% and energy rises 30%?

r.narrative: If UK visits fall 8% and energy rises 30%, FY2027 EBITDA falls by €43.6M, from €558.9M to €515.3M, and the margin from 18.1% to 16.9%. UK & Ireland is 13.1% of revenue (€405M); with 60% flow-through the visit drop costs €19.4M. Energy is €80.7M in FY2027 (net of the solar canopy), so +30% costs €24.2M. Mitigation — +2% on UK packages and re-contracting 60% of energy — recovers about €14.7M.

q: How did the Disney Adventure World opening change Park 2 attendance and merch per cap?

r.narrative: Since the new lands opened on 29 March 2026, Park 2 visits are up 35.1% (4.92M vs 3.64M, April–October vs the same months of 2025) and merchandise per cap is up €1.30 (+8.2%) to €17.08. Merchandise revenue rose €26.6M, of which about €20M from extra visits and €6.4M from higher spend per guest. The cost side: Park 2 cast overtime ran 10.0% of hours against a 5.5% standard (€2.9M above budget).

q: Generate a CFO briefing for the monthly close.

r.narrative:
October 2026 close — revenue €299.1M vs €305.3M budget (−€6.2M); EBITDA €54.1M vs €55.3M (−€1.2M), first month of FY2027.
• Resort Hotels −€3.3M: occupancy 88.2% vs 90.5%, ADR held at €369 — Santa Fe and Davy Crockett Ranch on UK package pickup.
• Park 2 visits +35% since the opening and merch per cap +8%, but overtime 10.0% of hours vs 5.5% (€2.9M).
• UK & Ireland visits −8.8% vs budget; French domestic +4.9% and Annual Pass offset most of it.
• FY2027 1+11 Forecast: €3,090M revenue, €559M EBITDA (−€12M vs budget). UK −8% and energy +30% would cost a further €43.6M.
Decisions: re-roster Park 2 on the ML forecast; UK value-hotel Christmas package; lock 60% of FY2027 electricity before 31 December.
